qa_pair.question: Discover the order-to-invoice relationship and count orders that have line items but no invoice. Return only the count.
Inspect the billing relationships and count invoiced orders for which no payment record exists. Return only the count.
Find the organization that owns the largest number of sales orders using captured relationships and live read-only data. Return only its name.
Discover the category, product, order-line and billing links. How many units of Studio-category products occur on invoiced orders with no payment record? Return only the number of units.
Find the payment status introduced by the migration that replaced the pending-payment index, then count payments currently using that status. Return only the count.
Inspect account column history and local migration source to identify the migration that introduced the current contact_email column by renaming its predecessor. Return only the migration ID.
Compare current account columns with unapplied migration definitions. Which pending migration adds last-seen tracking? Return only the migration ID.
Follow the line-adjustment relationship to its referenced order-line key. Which source columns are required, in captured key order? Return comma-separated column names without spaces.
Inspect the removed pending-payment index and the migration that replaced it. Which column is included, rather than a key column, in the replacement index? Return only that column name.
Discover the account-membership and sales-order relationships. Count memberships belonging to accounts that have never placed an order. Return only the count.
